name: print-social-lime-highlighted-portrait-course-flyer
title: Course flyer with monochrome portrait, lime bars and a lime circle
whatItIs: A white portrait flyer with a greyscale woman pointing at the viewer, a lime bar over her eyes, a large lime circle behind, and a headline 'start Learning today #create design.' where words sit in outlined boxes or lime blocks. Contact details are handwritten-underlined.
whatItMeans: Bold, direct and youthful; the pointing gesture and lime highlight say 'this is for you'.
techniques: Use a cutout monochrome portrait with direct gesture as the call to action.
Highlight words with lime rectangles and outline boxes.
Layer a big lime circle behind the subject.
Add a hand-drawn loop around the contact call.

vocabulary.definition: A coloured rectangle across a face or word.
A pointing pose addressing the viewer.
A word inside a thin border.
